Name: Skull Island Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[size=3]happy halloween!![b] [/b]here is a spoopy skull-shaped island map for you[/size]


[b]requirements

[/b]* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url]
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]daisyniko's tilesheets[/url]


[b]installation

[/b]1. install all of the required mods and download this one
2. extract the contents of the .zip to [i]/Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]
3. run the game with smapi and start a new save on the [i]riverland[/i] farm


[b]config options[/b]

FarmToReplace: Standard, Riverland, Forest, Hilltop, Wilderness (default Riverland)
* run the game once with the mod installed to generate a config.json file in ﻿the skull island mod folder
